name: Static
paragraphs: I enjoy helping people and anything involving technology. My interests include video games, movies, TV shows, cars, trucks, and all things mechanical.
After getting out of jail, I had nowhere to go. I had heard great things about Hope House Guthrie and needed a place to stay while working through drug court toward graduation.
Hope House has given me a safe, supportive, and structured place that has helped me create a healthy new life.
